title: Directive 2014/50/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 April 2014 on minimum requirements for enhancing worker mobility between Member States by improving the acquisition and preservation of supplementary pension rights

role_in_set: Occupational (supplementary) pensions, which 883/2004 does not coordinate: for a worker who moves to another Member State, vesting and waiting periods together capped at three years and a minimum vesting age of at most 21, refund of contributions where rights have not vested (Art 4), preservation of dormant rights (Art 5), and information rights (Art 6).
